html:
Given a list of strings, apply Python int(text) to each. Return the parsed integer or None when conversion raises ValueError.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      " 12 ",
      "x",
      "-7",
      "3.2"
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    12,
    null,
    -7,
    null
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Catch only the expected conversion exception.

Complexity: O(total input characters) time, O(n) output space
